# CLI Reference

> Derived from the Commander registrations in `core_engine/src/cli/run.ts`. Every command,
> argument, and option below is generated from the source — it cannot drift from the code.

Run any command via `npm run cli -- <command> [options]` (or the `k6-framework` binary).

Running with no subcommand on a TTY launches the interactive panel; non-TTY prints help.

## Commands

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `menu` | Launch the interactive command panel (same as running with no subcommand on a TTY) |
| `init` | Scaffold a new k6 performance project in the current directory |
| `new` | Interactive wizard to create a new test plan or runtime settings from templates |
| `docs` | Auto-generate Markdown reference documentation from JSON schemas |
| `generate-byos <team> <script-name>` | Scaffold a BYOS (Bring Your Own Script) template for pasting raw k6 scripts |
| `convert <input-script> <team> <script-name>` | Convert a conventional k6 script to a framework-compatible script with logExchange and transaction wrappers |
| `generate <team> <script-name>` | Generate a k6 script from a HAR recording |
| `correlate` | Scan a recording for dynamic values and (optionally) auto-correlate a generated script |
| `import` | Import requests from external sources (cURL in v1; Postman/OpenAPI planned) |
| `import curl <team> <script-name>` | Import a cURL command into a framework-shaped k6 script |
| `import postman <team> <script-name>` | Import a Postman v2.1 collection into a framework-shaped k6 script |
| `validate` | Validate configs and test plan before execution |
| `merge` | Merge per-machine distributed run artifacts into a single report |
| `collect` | Copy a finished local run folder into <collectDir>/shared_<runId>/<machine>/ |
| `agent` | Run a minimal reachability agent on a load generator (Phase-2 firewall probe) |
| `probe` | Probe reachability of one or more distributed agents from the controller |
| `share-setup` | Print how to share the controller results folder for distributed collection (manual this phase) |
| `monitor` | Live-monitor a distributed run (console, or --serve for a browser dashboard) |
| `signal` | Send abort/stop to a running distributed run (writes control_<runId>/control.json) |
| `templates` | Discover and view built-in config templates |
| `templates list` | List all available templates |
| `templates show <name>` | Show the content of a specific template |
| `features` | Discover built-in framework capabilities |
| `config` | Configuration utilities |
| `config inspect` | Inspect the final merged configuration resolution chain |
| `debug` | Run a script in debug mode (single VU) and generate an HTML diff report |
| `run` | Execute a test plan through k6 |

## Reference

### `menu`

Launch the interactive command panel (same as running with no subcommand on a TTY)

### `init`

Scaffold a new k6 performance project in the current directory

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
|--------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `-d, --dir <path>` | no |  | Target directory to scaffold into |

### `new`

Interactive wizard to create a new test plan or runtime settings from templates

### `docs`

Auto-generate Markdown reference documentation from JSON schemas

### `generate-byos <team> <script-name>`

Scaffold a BYOS (Bring Your Own Script) template for pasting raw k6 scripts

**Arguments:** `<team> <script-name>`

### `convert <input-script> <team> <script-name>`

Convert a conventional k6 script to a framework-compatible script with logExchange and transaction wrappers

**Arguments:** `<input-script> <team> <script-name>`

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
|--------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `--in-place` | no |  | Overwrite the input file instead of writing to testSuites/<team>/tests/ |

### `generate <team> <script-name>`

Generate a k6 script from a HAR recording

**Arguments:** `<team> <script-name>`

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
|--------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `--har <path>` | yes |  | Path to the .har file |

### `correlate`

Scan a recording for dynamic values and (optionally) auto-correlate a generated script

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
|--------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `--script <path>` | no |  | Generated script to correlate (required for --apply; auto-resolves its recording log) |
| `--har <path>` | no |  | Scan a .har file directly (list mode; request IDs follow HAR order) |
| `--log <path>` | no |  | Scan a recording-log.json (recommended — IDs align with the generated script) |
| `--manifest <path>` | no |  | Apply/list an existing correlation manifest instead of rescanning |
| `--list` | no |  | Print suspected dynamic values + write the manifest; do not modify the script (default) |
| `--apply <level>` | no |  | Rewrite the script: high | medium | all |
| `--out <path>` | no |  | Write the correlated script here (default: overwrite --script) |
| `--manifest-out <path>` | no |  | Where to write the manifest (default: alongside the recording log) |
| `--dry-run` | no |  | Alias for --list |

### `import`

Import requests from external sources (cURL in v1; Postman/OpenAPI planned)

### `import curl <team> <script-name>`

Import a cURL command into a framework-shaped k6 script

**Arguments:** `<team> <script-name>`

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
|--------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `--curl <string>` | no |  | Inline cURL command string (shell-quoting required; for browser-copied curls prefer --clipboard or --file) |
| `--file <path>` | no |  | Path to a file containing one or more cURL blocks (blank-line separated; optional `# name` comment names each transaction) |
| `--stdin` | no |  | Read cURL command from stdin (pipe-friendly: `clip | npm run import:curl … --stdin`) |
| `--clipboard` | no |  | Read cURL command from the OS clipboard (works directly with Chrome/Edge/Firefox "Copy as cURL") |
| `--transaction-name <name>` | no |  | Override the inferred transaction name (single-curl only) |

### `import postman <team> <script-name>`

Import a Postman v2.1 collection into a framework-shaped k6 script

**Arguments:** `<team> <script-name>`

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
|--------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `--file <path>` | yes |  | Path to a Postman v2.1 collection JSON file |
| `--folder <path>` | no |  | Only emit requests under this folder. Supports nested paths, e.g. "API/Auth" (includes the whole subtree) |
| `--split-per-request` | no |  | Emit one script per request (API) instead of a single combined script |

### `validate`

Validate configs and test plan before execution

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
|--------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `--plan <path>` | yes |  | Path to the test plan JSON file |
| `--env-config <path>` | no |  | Path to the environment config JSON file (auto-resolved if omitted) |
| `--runtime <path>` | no | `config/runtime_settings/default.json` | Path to the runtime_settings JSON file |
| `--data-root <path>` | no | `testSuites` | Root directory for data files |

| `--verbose` | no |  | Print verbose validation output including completeness score |

### `merge`

Merge per-machine distributed run artifacts into a single report

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
|--------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `--run-dir <path>` | yes |  | Shared run dir containing <machineName>/ subfolders for one runId |
| `--out <path>` | no |  | Output dir for the merged result (default: <run-dir>/Final_<testname>_<ts>) |
| `--wait` | no |  | Block until all --machines have collected in, then merge (auto-finalize) |
| `--machines <list>` | no |  | Comma-separated machine names to wait for (with --wait) |
| `--poll <sec>` | no | `5` | Poll interval while waiting |
| `--wait-timeout <sec>` | no | `600` | Max seconds to wait before giving up |

### `collect`

Copy a finished local run folder into <collectDir>/shared_<runId>/<machine>/

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
|--------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `--from <path>` | yes |  | Local run dir to collect (e.g. results/<plan>/<runId>) |
| `--into <path>` | no |  | Shared collect base dir (or K6_PERF_COLLECT_DIR) |
| `--machine <name>` | no |  | Machine name (or K6_PERF_MACHINE; defaults to hostname) |
| `--run-id <id>` | no |  | Shared runId (defaults to the run-manifest runId) |
| `--include-raw` | no |  | Also copy the large raw metrics-stream.json (excluded by default) |
| `--env-file <path>` | no | `.env` | Path to .env file |

### `agent`

Run a minimal reachability agent on a load generator (Phase-2 firewall probe)

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
|--------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `--port <port>` | no | `7070` | Port to listen on |
| `--host <host>` | no | `0.0.0.0` | Interface to bind (0.0.0.0 = all interfaces) |
| `--name <name>` | no |  | Machine name reported to the controller (defaults to hostname) |
| `--token <token>` | no |  | Optional shared secret required on every request (or K6_PERF_AGENT_TOKEN) |

### `probe`

Probe reachability of one or more distributed agents from the controller

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
|--------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `--agents <list>` | yes |  | Comma-separated agent targets, e.g. host1:7070,host2:7070 |
| `--port <port>` | no | `7070` | Default port when a target omits one |
| `--timeout <ms>` | no | `5000` | Per-agent timeout in milliseconds |
| `--token <token>` | no |  | Shared secret to send (or K6_PERF_AGENT_TOKEN) |
| `--tcp` | no |  | Raw TCP connect test (works on any port; no HTTP) — for firewall port discovery |

### `monitor`

Live-monitor a distributed run (console, or --serve for a browser dashboard)

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
|--------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `--live-dir <path>` | no |  | Path to the live_<runId> folder |
| `--collect-dir <path>` | no |  | Shared collect base dir (or K6_PERF_COLLECT_DIR; use with --run-id) |
| `--run-id <id>` | no |  | Shared runId (or K6_PERF_RUN_ID / derived from K6_PERF_START_AT) |
| `--interval <ms>` | no | `3000` | Refresh interval in milliseconds |
| `--once` | no |  | Print a single snapshot and exit (console only) |
| `--serve` | no |  | Serve a live browser dashboard instead of the console view |
| `--host <host>` | no |  | Dashboard bind host (or K6_PERF_DASHBOARD_HOST; default 127.0.0.1) |
| `--port <port>` | no |  | Dashboard port (or K6_PERF_DASHBOARD_PORT; default 8787) |
| `--no-open` | no |  | Do NOT auto-open the dashboard in your default browser (--serve only) |
| `--no-auto-merge` | no |  | Do NOT auto-merge when all machines finish (run `merge` yourself) |
| `--merge-timeout <sec>` | no | `300` | Max seconds to wait for collects before auto-merge gives up |
| `--env-file <path>` | no | `.env` | Path to .env file |

### `signal`

Send abort/stop to a running distributed run (writes control_<runId>/control.json)

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
|--------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `--mode <mode>` | yes |  | abort | stop |
| `--collect-dir <path>` | no |  | Shared collect base dir (or K6_PERF_COLLECT_DIR; use with --run-id) |
| `--run-id <id>` | no |  | Shared runId (or K6_PERF_RUN_ID / derived from K6_PERF_START_AT) |
| `--control-dir <path>` | no |  | Explicit control_<runId> dir (alternative to --collect-dir/--run-id) |
| `--effective-at <sec>` | no | `10` | stop only: seconds from now to drain together |
| `--env-file <path>` | no | `.env` | Path to .env file |
